finding.title: Protected response remains accessible after logout (synthetic demo)
finding.summary: A fresh request returned the demo protected marker after logout.
finding.expected: The old session is denied access to protected account data.
finding.actual: The synthetic recorded response contains the protected marker.
finding.impact: Potential continued account access. Confirm freshness, account identity and server-side behavior.
preconditions: Use two accounts owned by the tester.
Confirm that the selected endpoint requires authentication.
steps: Sign in as the test user.
Record a baseline response from GET /api/profile.
Complete logout and confirm its response.
Send one fresh request with the prior session in the authorized lab.
limitations: This example is fabricated and does not identify a real vulnerability.
remediation: Invalidate the server-side session during logout.
Add a regression test for previously issued sessions.

evidence.label: After-logout capture
evidence.observation: HTTP 200 and the synthetic protected marker.

privacy: Best-effort redaction; unknown secrets, identifiers and URL paths may remain.
